name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2025-02-12.353.3) introduced by Victorian Senator [Lidia Thorpe](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/victoria/lidia_thorpe) (Independent), which means it failed. ### Amendment text > *(1) Clause 1, page 1 (lines 6 and 7), omit "Electoral Reform", substitute "Sham Democracy".*
